source.detail: Self-described on its own site as 'a Saudi Arabian Family office officially established in the 1970s focused on investment and wealth management'. A multi-asset thematic investor across financial services, consumer, mining services, energy and technology, investing directly and co-investing. ⚠ Its LEI'd legal vehicle 'AlTouq S.A.' is registered in the British Virgin Islands; the operating family office is Riyadh-based. Do not record the BVI entity as the firm. Evidence: https://altouq.com/
